artworks.title: Cathedral Notre-Dame
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with the Cathédrale Notre-Dame as the central focus. People and boats populate the river, and sailing ships are docked along the riverbank. Historic buildings line the riverbank, displaying various architectural styles. The cathedral's spires tower in the distance, emphasizing verticality. The artwork is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black with fine brushstrokes.

artworks.title: Vue de Caen
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a scenic urban view from a slightly elevated perspective along a narrow waterway. In the forefront, a boat with a tall mast is on the water, flanked by sloping banks leading to rows of old buildings on each side. The densely packed buildings lead to the horizon just above the rooftops, with faint outlines of more structures visible beyond. A spire stands out in the distant skyline against a subtly textured sky. Detailed brushstrokes capture the architecture and flowing water, depicted in varying shades of gray and black for a timeless and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: View of the Pont des Saints-Pères
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a river and a bridge. The skyline of a city is faintly visible above the bridge. The brushwork consists of fine lines creating movement and texture. The use of etching or pen creates a black and white look. Trees and foliage are on the right with diagonal strokes. A boat moves along the river on the left. In the distance, buildings and possibly church steeples and a dome suggest an urban landscape. Clouds above cast light on the scene.

artworks.title: The Seine at Bas-Meudon
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on Japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside path with buildings and trees in the distance. The brushstroke style adds texture to the foliage and water. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of black and cream. There are a figure, wooden boats, and lush vegetation near the riverbank. A fence runs along the left side of the path. Tall trees line the river and cast shadows on the scene.

artworks.title: Studies for "Sowing the Word"
artworks.medium: graphite and chalk on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, William A. Clark Fund, 1969)
artworks.description: The image displays a drawing of a person in profile, with a detailed face, styled hair, and simple clothing. A larger sketch of the person's facial features is also shown separately. The drawing is done on blue paper with white and grey pencil, with minimal background details.

artworks.title: The Choice of a Model
artworks.artist: Eugene Andre Champollion, after Mariano Fortuny Marsal
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a detailed illustration of an ornate and luxurious interior. The room features rich decorations on the walls and ceilings, including moldings, sculptures, and carvings. A classical nude sculpture is displayed on a pedestal in the background, near large columns. The ceiling is adorned with a mural or fresco, and the floor is made of polished tiles. Additional ornate elements like mirrors and tapestries enhance the grandeur of the space. Intricate line work is used to depict the richness of the interior.

artworks.title: Le Ventre Législatif (The Legislative Belly)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1984)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men sitting on curved benches in a legislative setting. The men are depicted in an exaggerated and caricaturized style, with a variety of facial expressions and poses. They are dressed in formal 19th-century suits and the setting features labeled sections and barriers.

artworks.title: Easeby Abbey, Yorkshire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient, partially ruined stone structure, with arched Gothic architecture and ornate detailing. The structure dominates the scene against the sky. In the distance, faint outlines of hills or mountains can be seen. The image uses a monochromatic color palette, with fine pen or ink drawing technique emphasizing textures and patterns through lines and cross-hatching. Vegetation and rocks are seen around the structure, with a seated figure near the base. Foliage, trees, and stone walls blend in the background.

artworks.title: The Bugle Call
artworks.medium: etching in black on silk mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)

artworks.title: L'Or du Rhin -- Les Filles du Rhin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This image shows three figures with intertwining flowing lines around them. The figures are positioned closely together, with two facing each other at various angles and one figure's back partially turned. Their facial features are softly rendered with subtle expressions. One face is angled upwards. The figures have flowing hair and are draped in intricate garments suggested by fine lines merging within the setting. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The background consists of swirling patterns that enwrap the figures, creating a sense of motion and unity, contributing to the dreamlike quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Une station infiniment trop prolongée
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals sheltering from the rain. The scene is rendered with cross-hatched shading, showing a crowd under umbrellas, dressed in period clothing with top hats and long coats. The figures exhibit varied poses and expressions. The atmosphere suggests a wet, rainy day with lines that imply the direction and consistency of rain. The setting appears possibly urban.

artworks.title: Un Voyage d'Agrément de Paris a Orléons
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people seated closely together in what seems to be a train compartment. The focus is on their upper bodies and heads, emphasizing their hats and cloaks. Most individuals wear top hats, obscuring their faces, which vary in visibility due to turned heads and shadows. The group is dressed formally, likely in overcoats. A heart-shaped object is noticeable near the center. The background shows a simple train interior with streaked lines suggesting motion or weather. The image has faded colors, and there is some text above and below the illustration as part of the artwork.

artworks.title: Le Mont St. Michel
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image shows Mont Saint-Michel against a stormy sky. The horizon is low in the scene, with the abbey featuring pointed spires. The etched lines create texture and depth. A monochromatic color palette of black and gray gives a somber feel. A boat and figures with horses are in the foreground, with sand and water stretching into the distance.

artworks.title: Louis XV
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, posed formally. They have long, curly hair and delicate facial features. They are wearing a purple robe with gold fleur-de-lis symbols, a fur-lined cape, gold trimming, a lace collar, and a blue ribbon. The person is in an ornate oval frame with a green background.

artworks.title: L'enlevement d'Hélène
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, one carrying the other over their shoulder. The person being carried wears a cap and draped fabric, with elongated facial features and short hair. The carrier, also dressed in flowing clothes, has a determined posture. They are in an outdoor setting with mountains and a distant shore. Beside them is part of a ship with a decorative prow on the sand. The illustration has an old engraving style, with faint text above the scene.

artworks.title: Shakespeare and His Contemporaries
artworks.medium: engraving with chine collé on board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a group of twelve men in a room with ornate interior decoration. Ten men are visible from the waist up, while the other two are visible from the knees up. The men are seated or standing in various positions. A man, presumed to be William Shakespeare, is seated, with one hand on a table and the other on his knee. He has distinct facial features, a high forehead, a short beard, mustache, and short, wavy hair. The men are dressed in period attire from the late 16th to early 17th century. Some are holding quills and papers, and some are wearing hats. There is no prominent jewelry, but their outfits are richly detailed. The setting includes a heavy curtain, a window with detailed glasswork, wood-paneled walls, and what appears to be an architectural fireplace or alcove. Books and papers are scattered throughout.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Receiving His Patrimony
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows three men indoors. The first man is seated in a red ornate armchair, with white hair and a serious expression, dressed in a blue coat, white shirt, and tan pants. The second man stands in the center, with reddish hair, a neutral expression, and wearing a brown coat, bright yellow vest, and white shirt. The third man sits on the right, leaning over a green table with dark hair tied back, dressed similarly to the others. On the table are stacks of coins and a ledger. The background has a bookshelf with orange-bound books, a globe, a window with a tree, a clock, and an ornate carpet.

artworks.title: A Medieval Town
artworks.medium: etching and engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is an etching of a village scene with rooftops and a tower in the center. In the distance, hills and a cloudy sky can be seen. The style features detailed lines and textures, with a monochrome color palette. Two figures are visible, one reading a book and the other leaning on a railing. Leafy branches frame the scene in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Isles of the Morning
artworks.medium: aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a view from the shoreline looking out towards the sea and distant mountains. The horizon is slightly above the center with mountains visible along it. The brushstrokes give a blended effect with a pattern suggesting clouds and waves. The color palette includes muted tones like gray and taupe. The shoreline curves along the left with waves rolling onto the shore, extending to distant peaks. The vast sky has soft lighting.

artworks.title: Summer Morning
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image is captured from a slightly elevated perspective, showing a landscape sloping down towards a body of water. The horizon meets distant hills, partially concealed by layers of foliage. The style of the print features soft, blurred edges and smooth tonal transitions, akin to charcoal or soft-focused techniques, creating an atmospheric effect. The color palette consists of sepia tones, giving the image a serene quality. In the foreground, there is a stream bordered by rocks and grass, with two figures wading in the distance. Trees with broad canopies line the stream, contributing to the tranquil ambiance.

artworks.title: Bolton Abbey
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees on the left leading to ancient ruins in the center against a hillside backdrop. Hills and fields extend into the distance. The scene is depicted with detailed brushstrokes and etching lines, with a color palette leaning towards sepia tones.

artworks.title: Low Tide
artworks.medium: aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a monochromatic coastal scene with a sandy beach stretching into the distance. The horizon is low with the calm sea meeting the sky. There is a faint outline of land on the horizon. The sky has smooth gradations and transitions between shades of gray, creating a realistic cloud formation. The color palette is grayscale, enhancing the serene mood. The sand close to the viewer has ripples and curves, leading the eye to smaller figures in the distance for scale. A person and a dog are walking on the beach.

artworks.title: Santa Maria del Sasso, Locarno
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a hillside town with a church overlooking a lake. The viewpoint is elevated, displaying the architectural details of the town and extending to the lake. A church with a bell tower is at the top center, surrounded by buildings with tiled roofs cascading down the slope. Distant mountains frame the lake. The etching features fine lines, adding texture to the structures and defining the landscape. The color scheme is sepia, creating a serene atmosphere and highlighting the detailed elements of the scene.

artworks.title: Cardigan Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a river with a rowing boat close to the viewer. In the distance, there are trees, a steeple, and a tower peeking above them. The sky is prominent in the composition. The artwork features sketch-like brushstrokes, monochromatic colors of black and grey, and detailed reflections of boats, trees, and structures on the water.
